ruleset.Summary: The Ruleset holds a game's whole configuration: its types, rules and contents.
ruleset.Usage: Work in a draft, publish once “Publish readiness” reports nothing, then activate the version to play it.

definitionType.Summary: A Definition type describes a family of game elements (attribute, skill, resource…): its capabilities and fields.
definitionType.Usage: For each capability, choose whether it is unavailable, optional, on by default or required. This type's description serves as help in the editor of its Definitions.

definition.Summary: A Definition is a concrete game element of a type: Strength, Bow, Vitality…
definition.Usage: Its capabilities (value, pool, collection, state) decide what Formulas can read and what Effects can change.

parameter.Summary: A Parameter is a typed Ruleset constant, reusable everywhere.
parameter.Usage: Prefer a Parameter to a hard-coded number: it changes in one place.

formula.Summary: A Formula computes a value from Parameters, other Formulas, references and the context.
formula.Usage: Its result type is checked: a “number” Formula cannot produce text.

formulaBinding.Summary: A derived output computes a Definition output with a Formula instead of storing it.
formulaBinding.Usage: The output then becomes read-only: no Effect can write it.

condition.Summary: A Condition is an expression that produces true or false.
condition.Usage: Actions, Outcomes, Triggers, Permission rules and Modifiers use it to decide.

roll.Summary: A Roll is a dice roll described by a safe formula (for example 1d20 or 2d6+1).
roll.Usage: A Test uses it; a Test can also skip the Roll and start from a Formula.

outcome.Summary: An Outcome is a possible result of a Test (success, failure, critical…).
outcome.Usage: The first Outcome whose Condition is true wins, by decreasing priority.

test.Summary: A Test reads typed inputs, optionally rolls, computes a total and a margin, then picks an Outcome.
test.Usage: The Test's Formulas read its values in variables.test (inputs, total, target, margin).

effect.Summary: An Effect changes a mutable Definition output with an operation (set, add, subtract, multiply, toggle).
effect.Usage: The target must be mutable and the operand of a compatible type.

action.Summary: An Action is what a player or the GM triggers: Conditions, costs, an optional Test, then Effects.
action.Usage: If a Condition is false nothing is written. Costs are paid before effects. An acquisition Action adds Definitions to the character before its effects. With several targets, costs are paid once and the Test, Effects and Table run for each target.

permissionPolicy.Summary: A Permission decides who may read, write, execute or configure what. The GM always has every right.
permissionPolicy.Usage: The most specific scope decides (one object, then a kind of object, then the Ruleset). Among its matching rules (role, minimum ownership, users, Condition), the highest priority wins and DENY wins a tie; otherwise the default effect applies. Without any Permission, Foundry ownership decides.

eventType.Summary: An Event type describes a game fact (attack resolved, turn started…) and its data.
eventType.Usage: Triggers react to Events; Actions can emit them.

trigger.Summary: A Trigger reacts to an Event type: it filters, checks its Conditions, then runs Actions.
trigger.Usage: Everything goes through Actions. Who acts: the one who caused the event, or the one it aimed at for a reaction (parry, thorns). Offered: the Actions are proposed to who acts instead of running. A reroll Action run this way replays the use that caused the event; keep the dice for a Shield spell.

contentType.Summary: A content type describes elements stored in Foundry (items, spells, gear…) and their fields.
contentType.Usage: Choose whether they live as Items or Actors, and under which subtype.

contentTemplate.Summary: A content template is a concrete element ready to be given to a character.
contentTemplate.Usage: It can grant Definitions and Actions, and offer choices on acquisition. Its optional acquisition Action adds its Conditions and costs to the acquisition, in a single write.

modifier.Summary: A Modifier adjusts a final value (bonus, penalty, cap) while its Conditions are true.
modifier.Usage: A Modifier that no Action applies works everywhere, while its Conditions are true. A Modifier applied by an Action only works on the Actor that received it, for its duration. Stacking rules decide whether several Modifiers add up or the best one wins.

duration.Summary: A Duration says how long a state lasts: instant, fixed, until an Event, while a Condition holds, until removed or until a date.
duration.Usage: Pick a mode: only the fields that mode needs are shown. A world time is counted in seconds.

creationSystem.Summary: A creation system describes the steps of creating a character.
creationSystem.Usage: Each step offers a choice of definitions or contents, points to spread, a roll, or a final review. A step can depend on a Condition, and the last steps can repeat term after term (careers, lifepaths).

progressionSystem.Summary: A progression system says how a character grows: advancements bought with XP or points, and milestones reached at a level.
progressionSystem.Usage: An advancement raises a Definition and pays a cost Formula from a currency; its cost can grow with the current value. A milestone grants Definitions and runs an Action once its Condition holds; an Action input lets the player choose (a feat). Levels themselves are a Formula over the XP.

sheetDefinition.Summary: A sheet is what players see on an Actor or an Item: tabs, sections, lists of the Definitions they hold, values and Action buttons.
sheetDefinition.Usage: Click a block of the sheet (or in the Layers) to change it in the tools on the left. Under “Add”, click a block or an element of the Ruleset to add it into the selection, or drag it onto the sheet; drag the blocks to move them. Copy, paste and duplicate work from one sheet to another (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D). Without any sheet, Actors and Items show an automatic sheet. Players choose the sheet in Foundry's sheet choice.

tag.Summary: A tag freely marks any Ruleset object.

table.Summary: A Table turns a roll into a result: critical hits, wild magic, random encounters, injuries.
table.Usage: Pick the Roll and an optional bonus, then give each row its range and the Actions it runs. An Action rolls the Table after its Effects; the row's Actions run in the same step.

die.Summary: A Die has faces of its own: narrative dice with symbols, a d6 whose 1 is a special face, a stunt die.
die.Usage: Give it a letter, then its counters and its faces. A Roll throws it with that letter (2dp for two dice). A Formula reads a counter over all the dice thrown; a negative count cancels (a failure counts -1 success).

scale.Summary: A Description scale turns a number into words: "Seems in great shape", "Badly hurt", "Exceptional".
scale.Usage: Give each band its range and words. Link the scale to a Definition type (all its Definitions) or to one Definition. On a sheet, a value shown "As a description" shows these words instead of the number, for observers for instance.

StackingMode.replace: Last in order within its group

Permission.Precedence: The policy with the most specific scope decides. Among its matching rules the highest priority wins, and Deny wins a tie. If no rule matches, the default effect applies.

ActionInput.Help: Values the player or the GM chooses each time the Action is used (a slot level, a difficulty). Formulas, Conditions and dice read them as variables.input.<id> or @input.<id>.

TurnOrder.now: Acts now, before the current turn

Action.EventPayloadsHelp: Each field of a ticked event takes the value of a Formula, computed for this Action once its Effects are applied, or a fixed value. The event always carries the key of the Outcome too.

Progression.AdvancementsHelp: What a character buys with a currency (XP, points): each purchase raises one Definition by the step. The cost Formula reads variables.advance.current and variables.advance.next.
Progression.Label: Label
Progression.MilestonesHelp: Reached when their Condition holds (a level): they grant their Definitions and run their Action once per character. The Action's inputs are the choices of that milestone.

Initiative.Help: Actors under this Ruleset roll this Test, or draw a row of this Table, in the combat tracker; the result is their initiative.

Shared.Help: Values held once for the whole game instead of once per character. For example, a "GM reserve" Definition in World resources: an Action lowers it with the World role, and everyone sees the same counter. Each combat's resources start again from their starting value in every new combat, like an escalation die. Everyone sees them, and the GM changes them, from the Shared resources button in the combat tracker.
Shared.None: The active Ruleset has no shared resources.

Group.Help: A group Test is made by each member before the Action's own Test; Formulas read the results in variables.group (count, best, worst, sum, outcomes). A linked role is the first Actor of a collection of references, such as the vehicle a pilot crews.
Group.MembersChosen: Chosen when the Action is used

Test.ExtraRollsHelp: After the Roll, each extra roll whose Condition holds adds to the roll total or takes from it (a 10 adds a die, a 1 takes one away).

Die.LetterHelp: One lowercase letter, other than c, d or f, which Foundry keeps for its own dice.
Die.CountersHelp: What the faces count, like Success or Advantage. Dice sharing a counter name add up.
Die.FacesHelp: One card per face, in order. A count can be negative to cancel another die's symbol.

characteristics.Title: Characteristics
characteristics.Summary: A list of scores (Strength, Agility…) of one type, with a computed modifier if needed.
characteristics.Limits: Score bounds are set on the type. Another modifier rule goes through "Computed value".

skills.Title: Skills
skills.Summary: A list of skills, each linked or not to a characteristic, with its roll bonus.
skills.Limits: The bonus is one Formula per skill; a test uses it by choosing it as its bonus.

derivedValue.Title: Computed value
derivedValue.Summary: A value computed from others (Defense, Speed, Initiative…).
derivedValue.Limits: The calculation replaces the final value; a value already computed keeps its first calculation.

bounds.Title: Bounds of a value
bounds.Summary: The minimum or maximum of a type of values (every characteristic) or of some values, for everyone or only in one case: PCs, an Actor type, a Content…
bounds.Limits: Replaces the bound in place; with a condition, the old bound stays for every other case. Gauges (resources) have their bounds in their slot.

when.Label: Only when (otherwise the current bound stays)

resource.Title: Resource
resource.Summary: A gauge that goes up and down between a minimum and a maximum (hit points, mana, ammunition…).
resource.Limits: One gauge per resource; other gauges are added in the Definition editor.

test.Title: Roll or test
test.Summary: A dice roll compared with a difficulty, with its results: success, failure, critical, fumble.
test.Limits: Finer degrees of success are added afterwards in the Test editor.

outcomes.Label: Existing results, in order (else created here)

Option.atLeast: Equal to or above the difficulty
Option.atMost: Equal to or below the difficulty

critical.Label: Critical on a natural roll of

fumble.Label: Fumble on a natural roll of

action.Label: Add a button to make this roll

attack.Title: Attack
attack.Summary: A roll to hit, then damage taken from a resource of the target, doubled on a critical.
attack.Limits: Several attacks per round, range and ammunition are set with "Cost" and Actions.

criticalDouble.Label: Double the dice on a critical

state.Title: Condition
state.Summary: A condition that is applied and removed (Poisoned, Stunned, Blessed…), with a duration and its penalties.
state.Limits: Penalties apply while the condition is active; effects on each turn go through "Trigger".

modifiers.Label: Effects on values while it lasts

applyAction.Label: Add a button to apply it

removeAction.Label: Add a button to remove it

cost.Title: Cost
cost.Summary: An Action spends a resource (ammunition, mana…) and can be refused when not enough is left.
cost.Limits: The cost is added to the Action without changing what it already does.

required.Label: Refuse the Action when not enough is left

consumable.Title: Consumable
consumable.Summary: An item with doses (potion, charges…): each use spends a dose and has its effect.
consumable.Limits: Doses live on the Definition; an inventory item goes through a Content type.

level.Title: Level and experience
level.Summary: A level that follows experience, by a fixed step or a table, and a button to award experience.
level.Limits: What each level grants is set with "Progression" (milestones).

award.Label: Add a button to award experience

encumbrance.Title: Encumbrance
encumbrance.Summary: An "overloaded" Condition, true when the load exceeds a computed capacity.
encumbrance.Limits: Penalties for overload are added with a Condition or Modifiers that use this Condition.

advantage.Title: Advantage and situational bonus
advantage.Summary: When a Condition holds, existing tests get advantage, disadvantage, an extra die, a bonus or a penalty.
advantage.Limits: Added to the chosen tests without changing their base dice.

damageTypes.Title: Damage types
damageTypes.Summary: Damage types (Fire, Cold…) with immunity, resistance and vulnerability, and a factor per type for attacks.
damageTypes.Limits: An attack applies the factor by choosing it as its "Damage factor".

power.Title: Power or spell
power.Summary: A power: attack, saving throw, automatic effect, healing or a condition, with an optional cost and levels.
power.Limits: Area, range and components stay descriptions; more effects are added in the Action editor.

threshold.Title: Automatic threshold
threshold.Summary: When a value crosses a threshold (hit points at 0…), a condition is applied, then removed when it goes back.
threshold.Limits: Checked on the chosen event; the Condition can also mark defeated combatants.

remove.Label: Remove the condition when the threshold is no longer met

rest.Title: Rest and recovery
rest.Summary: A rest that restores resources, clears conditions, and can happen by itself each game day.
rest.Limits: An existing rest is completed, never changed.

daily.Label: Also each game day, by itself

initiative.Title: Initiative
initiative.Summary: Turn order in combat: the initiative roll, a reroll each round, a tie-break, several passes.
initiative.Limits: One initiative per Ruleset: if it already exists, change it in the Ruleset form.

creation.Title: Character creation
creation.Summary: Creation steps: picking contents, their own choices, spending points, choosing values, a final review.
creation.Limits: An existing creation gets new steps at the end, without touching the others.

Option.contentChoices: Choices of the contents picked before

choicesLater.Label: The choices of these Contents are made at a later step

progression.Title: Progression
progression.Summary: Raise values by spending a currency (XP, practice…), or gain things at level milestones.
progression.Limits: An existing progression gets new entries, without touching the others.

scale.Title: Descriptive scale
scale.Summary: Words for ranges of values (Frail, Sturdy…), shown instead of the number to those who cannot see it.
scale.Limits: Linked only to values and types that have no scale yet.

contentType.Title: Content type
contentType.Summary: A kind of content (weapon, spell, origin…) with its fields, for items and creation choices.
contentType.Limits: The contents themselves are made in the configurator or by import.

permission.Title: Permissions
permission.Summary: Keep Actions, changing values, or giving Contents for the GM or trusted roles.
permission.Limits: One permission per entry; finer rules are set in the Permissions editor.

Option.definitionType: Changing the values of a type

definitionType.Title: Definition type
definitionType.Summary: A family of values (characteristic, skill, resource, condition…) and what it can do.
definitionType.Limits: One capability; others are added in the type editor.

value.Title: Value
value.Limits: For an automatic calculation, see "Computed value".

parameter.Title: Parameter
parameter.Summary: A number or setting of the Ruleset, named once and read by calculations (a difficulty, a base).
parameter.Limits: The same for every character; a value of each one's own is a Value.

formula.Title: Formula
formula.Summary: A named calculation, reused by tests, effects and values.
formula.Limits: An identical calculation already present is reused.

condition.Title: Condition rule
condition.Summary: A true-or-false check (has enough mana, is invisible…), reused by Actions and triggers.
condition.Limits: An identical condition already present is reused.

roll.Title: Roll
roll.Summary: Dice to throw, and other dice while a Condition holds (announced dice, an advantage).
roll.Limits: The dice may read the Content used (@content.field) and the Action's inputs (@input.id).

outcome.Title: Test result
outcome.Summary: A result (success, critical…) a Test recognises by its Condition; several Tests may share it.
outcome.Limits: The order of results is set on each Test.

duration.Title: Duration
duration.Summary: How long an applied state lasts: rounds, days, until an event or until removed.
duration.Limits: A Duration serves every Action that chooses it.

effect.Title: Effect
effect.Summary: A change to a value, a gauge or a field of the Content used: subtract, add, set, multiply, by a number, a calculation or dice.
effect.Limits: An Effect works when an Action runs it.

Option.contentField: A field of the Content used

action.Title: Action
action.Summary: A play button: its questions, conditions, costs, roll, effects, conditions applied, and what each result does.
action.Limits: The chosen entries must exist; make them first with their path.

counter.Title: Counter
counter.Summary: A value raised with a click and reset on an event (attacks this round…).
counter.Limits: To limit an Action with it, add a Condition on the counter.

trigger.Title: Trigger
trigger.Summary: Run Actions by themselves on an event (start of round, turn, time passing…).

table.Title: Random table
table.Summary: A table rolled with dice (criticals, hit locations, encounters…), each row able to run Actions.
table.Limits: Rows with neither "From" nor "To" never come up at random.

die.Title: Special die
die.Summary: A die with custom faces (symbols, successes, advantages…) that add to counters.
die.Limits: Faces are rolled by a dice formula using the die's letter.

Assistant.Title: Assistant
Assistant.Intro: Choose on the left the rule to build. The assistant asks a few questions, shows what it will create, reuse, complete or change, then writes it all at once when you apply. It never removes anything, and only a path made for it (the bounds of a value) changes an existing setting.
Assistant.ReadOnly: This version is validated: the assistant can show it but not complete it. Create a new version to change it.
Assistant.AppliedIntro: Done. Open an entry to adjust it, or try the rule right away.
Assistant.Stale: The Ruleset changed since this plan (another window or GM). Check the plan again, then apply.
Assistant.PanelFailed: This panel from another module could not be shown (see the console).
Assistant.Invalid: The plan still has errors: fix the answers shown.

Word.Nothing: Nothing to do yet: answer the questions.

Error.NOT_ACCEPTED: This entry does not fit here
Error.ALREADY_SET: Already set: the assistant replaces nothing
Error.INVALID: The result would not be valid

Integration.SectionFailed: This section of another module could not list its cards (see the console).
Integration.ActionFailed: This action of another module failed: {error}
